title: 400 Millennium Blvd (Z-26-18)
body:
400 Millennium Blvd (Z-26-18)
Changes to the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that the applicant has submitted an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies before anything can be built.
Activa Holdings Inc. is proposing to rezoning Blocks 6 and 8, within Draft Plan of Subdivision 30T-23401, from Residential Seven (R7) to Residential Five (R5) to permit single detached dwellings within these blocks, whereas the existing R7 zone only permits townhouses.
The applicant has requested that the existing site specific provisions already applicable to the R5 zone on the subject site through Exception 294 continue to apply to Blocks 6 and 8
.
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
A previous Official Plan Amendment (OPA 53), Zoning By-law Amendment (Z-24-04) and Draft Plan of Subdivision (30T-23401) has already been approved by Council for 400 Millennium Blvd in November 2025. For additional information on the previously approved applications please refer to
https://www.engagewr.ca/400-millennium-blvd
.
Building height, units, housing types
Tallest single detached/semi-detached/townhouse: 11 metres (for entire property)
Tallest multi-unit building: 20 metres (for entire property)
Number of units: 572-623 (for entire property)
Housing types: apartments, townhouses, semi-attached, single detached
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the delegated staff authority, or ask a question to learn more about this application by contacting the planner.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.
